incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=runtime-router env=prod alert=router_p95_strobe
pagerduty: Notification sent to rotation @oncall-sre
devon: acked in PD, picking this up
elena: on my way, seeing a tiny p95 blip on router in eu-west-1, looks like a canary spike
maria: +1 saw a ~30s spike hitting /v1/generate, no 5xxs, just latency
devon: pulling logs, running quick query: ```curl -s 'https://logs.redwood.internal/api/query?q=router,p95,last10m'``` — getting a few noisy hosts
incident-bot: Alert transitioned to RESOLVED (auto-resolve threshold met) :white_check_mark:
devon: weird — PD auto-resolved while we're still looking, still want to finish check in thread
sanjay: double-checking rollout config — there was a small canary job running for ~23m, could be warmup noise
elena: traces look like KV cache cold hits + one overloaded proxy box, autoscaler didn't spin because it was a sub-threshold burst
maria: customer-impact check: no error spikes in prod, SLOs unchanged, no support tickets or UX reports
devon: quarantined host i-0abc123 and restarted proxy, p95 back to baseline now
sanjay: going to bump the canary rate limiter and increase alert flap suppression from 3m -> 8m for router_p95, will open infra PR
devon: created follow-up ticket INF-4123 and assigned to elena + sanjay — summary: transient router p95 strobe during canary, no customer impact
elena: adding runbook note: if PD auto-resolves before ops ack, post update in thread and escalate only if customer-impact is confirmed
maria: q: should we change incidentbot's auto-resolve window? it's pretty aggressive for these short warmup spikes
devon: prefer tuning alert policy and canary traffic today rather than changing bot behavior. we'll revisit if noisy persists
maria: :thumbsup: I'll ping solutions and support to watch for any late signals
incident-bot: Incident closed. Reactions: devon :eyes:, elena :thumbsup:
devon: closing thread — no customer impact, action items tracked in INF-4123 and infra PR 2891, adding to next oncall retro
sanjay: thanks all, tidy handoff, will add brief RCA note post-retro
